note: Work: 18. Ley General de Trabajo (Ley Núm. 4/2021, de 3 de diciembre, published January 2022; the text as the COMIFAC observatory's library holds it, the government's own gazette site not being found) art. 42: the legal age to work in Equatorial Guinea is eighteen; from sixteen, with the parents' or legal representative's authorisation or the Ministry of Labour's approval, a minor may do light work that harms neither health, morals, development nor schooling, and never dangerous work: not held. Performers: barred, the reading being that art. 42 has no exception for performers below 16, and art. 44(2) leaves 'trabajadores artistas' to a special provision that wasn't found; a 16- or 17-year-old performer would fall under the light-work rule, which the form doesn't hold. Majority: null; the civil law in force (the Spanish Civil Code as inherited) wasn't read. Service: null; no military service law was found by a web search (2026-10-31).

sources.title: República de Guinea Ecuatorial: Ley Núm. 4/2021, General de Trabajo (copy held by the Observatoire des Forêts d’Afrique Centrale, COMIFAC)
sources.said: Ley Núm. 4/2021, de fecha 3 de Diciembre, General de Trabajo en la República de ... Artículo 42. Trabajo de Menores. 1. La edad ... legal para trabajar en Guinea Ecuatorial es la ... de dieciocho años. ... 2. No obstante, quienes hayan cumplido dieciséis años, previa autorización de los padres o ... prestar servicios artísticos a favor de una enti- ... gulará por una disposición especial.
